correctness.rationale: Active translation rows are indexed by S-{0,1,2}; m>=min(N,s+2) and sum row support sizes=3s. Factoring frequency monomials yields Z<=3s-m+B for endpoint-only rows B<=s, hence |supp V_gf|>=(N+1)m-3s-B. The proof handles s>=3 and N=6 edge cases separately and correctly enforces >=4N; 826 support subsets for N=6..9 were independently checked against these exact row-counting bounds. For s=2, separated supports have >=5N-2 or 6N, while adjacent supports have four rows and exactly two possible one-root cancellations. Their ratio cosets C1=-bar a/bar b mu_N and C2=-bar b/bar c mu_N coincide iff ac/b² in mu_N. Independent direct N=6 composite-cycle complex Fourier sums confirm 4N-2 vs 4N-1 and singleton 3N. Finite checks are illustrative, not a proof for all N.
